title: Correct final answer(s)
description: Essential: The response must give at least one of the two possible numerical answers (7/30 s or 0.9 s) for the time to reach point M for the third time.

title: Period determination
description: Important: The solution must correctly derive the period of the SHM from the given time intervals, considering the two possible initial directions of motion.

title: Interpretation of time intervals
description: Important: The reasoning must correctly relate the 0.2 s (first time to M) and the additional 0.1 s (to reach M a second time) to fractions of the oscillation period.

title: Third time calculation
description: Important: The method for calculating the time to the third visit to point M must be clearly shown, typically by subtracting the time to the second visit from the full period.

title: Direction assumption stated
description: Optional: The solution explicitly states the assumed initial direction of motion (left or right from equilibrium) and acknowledges the two possible scenarios.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: All time values are presented with correct units (seconds) throughout the calculation.

title: Incorrect fraction of period
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student misinterprets the time intervals (e.g., assumes 0.2 s is a quarter period) without proper kinematic reasoning for SHM.

title: Sign or arithmetic error
description: Pitfall: Penalize for basic arithmetic mistakes in calculating the period or the final time, especially in handling fractions.
